prd.problem: The catalog mixes provisional identity candidates, graphics, counter versions and scenario instances. Players need faction-separated browsing and a large rotatable unit detail view; builders need a reconciled unit inventory, stable IDs and source-linked TOE/equipment data before treating the 1301 missing art sets (1356 candidates minus 55 on main) as confirmed unique units.
prd.why_now: The supplied VASSAL 2.1.0 module (buildFile.xml) adds organization charts, counter layers and scenario setups. Verified counts: 2468 PieceSlots with 2468 distinct GPIDs, 1307 distinct entry names, 1194 slots under 'Organisation Charts (with units)', 1164 in the hidden duplicate 'Units' palette, 102 markers and 8 on the main map; 83 OC chart boards in images/. None of these is an adjudicated unit count. The VASSAL org charts include the Sirte, Marmarica, Cirene and Catanzaro divisions whose Organization-at-Arrival sheets the catalog could not locate (errata 4.44b says they were omitted), and changelog v2.1 records counter corrections (LTC LX->LXI, Tobruk V Art CD symbol, 44 Inf 57th AT and 5 Ind 25th/31st symbols). Main has 55 unique art sets; origin/feat/identity-art-batch-19 (which contains batch-18) adds 6 more for 61. Graziani's Offensive is the first certified scenario, so its order of battle sets the first data and art wave.
prd.users: Players exploring factions and units; Kevin reviewing identity/art architecture; simulation builders consuming TOE, equipment, morale, arrivals and organization data through crates/cna-catalog; artists producing unique sprites.
prd.value: One catalog orb owns identity reconciliation, the new crates/cna-catalog contract crate, public/data/unit-catalog.json and unit-identities.json, provenance, sprite manifests and the catalog UI (crates/frontend/src/catalog.rs, inventory.rs, catalog_view.rs, src/styles/catalog.css). Milestones: (E1) source census, branch reconciliation and identity/version contract with a Graziani fixture; (E2) unit/permutation architecture report from adjudicated identities; (E3) faction browser and sidebar/detail modal with rotation and counter/symbol versions; (E4) canonical simulation-facing data, Graziani first; (E6) bounded unique-sprite production waves with fixed membership; (E7) coverage acceptance and release. Unique historical units get unique sprite sets; versions of one unit (reduced, reorganised, alternate counters, state layers) use counters/symbols; a separate art variant needs a recorded material-equipment justification. The catalog publishes stable IDs and schemas early and never depends on the finished simulation or movement; simulation alone interprets gameplay rules.
success_metrics: crates/cna-catalog v1 distinguishes CanonicalUnit, CounterRepresentation (VASSAL GPID, printed counter, sheet), StateVersion (layer/level), ScenarioInstanceRef (ID only; instances belong to simulation) and AssetRef; source GPIDs, aliases, original labels and evidence links stay traceable.

Every one of the 2468 VASSAL slots is accounted for in a census (unit, marker, duplicate palette, label, chart) including conflicting labels/images and missing image references; identical names or image hashes alone never merge identities (mutation test).

docs/catalog/architecture.md reports reviewed canonical identities, unresolved candidates, versions, markers and asset coverage separately and describes state axes (TOE, attachment, reduction, morale, fuel/supply) as unbounded game state, not a finite permutation count.

The catalog separates Axis (German, Italian) and Allied (Commonwealth plus contingents) and opens a main-to-detail modal with a left sidebar and large detail area; users rotate through the actual 18 supplied views and inspect counter/symbol versions with keyboard and pointer.
The viewer labels static directional frames as frames (not animation), shows missing frames/assets honestly, and is verified on light and dark backgrounds without clipping or bleed.

Each confirmed unique unit has a distinct sprite set or is explicitly uncovered; generic role art never counts as coverage; every production leaf has fixed membership and passes provenance, alpha/geometry and light/dark inspection gates.

TOE, equipment, morale, arrivals, withdrawals and organization records consumed by simulation are source-linked with unresolved status handling; errata from ERR (4.43a, 4.44a-c, 4.49) are applied exactly once with a record; conflicting VASSAL values are reviewed, not copied.
No catalog leaf depends on simulation rules or movement; the only upstream dependency is the simulation-owned shared scaffold (workspace member and frontend split).
out_of_scope: Replacing unique-unit coverage with generic equipment-family art.
Treating all 1356 provisional candidates as distinct historical units, or committing to 1301 new art sets before reconciliation.
Authoritative combat, movement, logistics or per-game private state in the reference catalog.
Importing player names or passwords from VASSAL saves (all four supplied .vsav files contain PLAYER records with non-empty password fields) or assuming supplied artwork may be redistributed.
Editing simulation, map or movement files; boundary changes go to the owning orb.
open_questions: Exact unique-unit and material equipment-variant totals are outputs of E2, not assumptions; pending identities stay visible until adjudicated.

Reference catalog information is distinct from enemy-instance intelligence: knowing a reference unit exists must not reveal an opponent's live strength, cargo, attachments or hidden composition (L21 3.61).

Record source copyright/redistribution permission before shipping source-derived counter imagery (VASSAL SVG counters by Mitch Guthrie, (c) 1979 SPI / (c) 2022 White Box Games); generated uniforms are illustrative, not certified historical uniforms.
Merge order for the unmerged art branches: batch-19 contains batch-18; E1.I1.S1 proposes merging batch-19 only, pending Kevin's approval of the branch.

epics.title: Unique-sprite production waves

subissues.title: Sprite gate checker and proof sheets
subissues.goal: Automate the checks every batch must pass.
scope: crates/cna-catalog/src/bin/sprite-check.rs: 1536x768 RGBA atlas, 18 non-empty distinct 256 px cells, transparent margins, portrait matches a frame, unique files across identities, manifest provenance (Painter attachment URLs/prompt summary), light/dark proof sheet output for inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Checker rejects a shared-role atlas and a duplicated atlas (mutation tests).

subissues.title: Re-gate the existing ready sets
subissues.goal: Check the already-produced unique sets with the same gates before counting them as coverage.
scope: Membership is fixed: the 55 ready identities on main plus the 6 batch-19 identities if E1.I1.S1 was approved and merged (61 total); run sprite-check and inspect light/dark proofs; downgrade any failing set to candidate with a recorded reason.
acceptance_criteria: Every member is ready-and-passing or downgraded with a reason; counts recorded in docs/unit-identities.md.
